title: Paper Sage
summary: A warm light theme inspired by archival paper, with sage navigation and ink-like typography.
details: Paper Sage is a daylight palette for reading, reviewing evidence, and drafting manuscripts. Warm neutral surfaces avoid stark white glare, while sage accents and ink-like text keep the workspace calm and unmistakably structured.
features: Warm paper surfaces for daylight reading and manuscript work
Ink-like body text with calm sage navigation accents
Accessible research-state colors tuned for light backgrounds
